title: DCLab Code: a live end-to-end pass of every new feature
request: Keep building: pick the next most useful dclab-code improvement and do it.
plan: Run every new feature with a real model, on its own port and folder
Fix what the live run shows

decisions.decision: A live pass of every new feature with a real model, on its own port and folder
decisions.why: the fake agent cannot show what the SDK and the page do together; each earlier live run found something

change: web/app.js: the model and mode menus start from the config's defaults until the person picks; today's spend summed from the sessions as they update; the undo button of an untracked file says Remove. Then (19bff54): a banner when the running server is older than the code on disk, and Restart Server (⌘⇧R) in the Mac app.

findings.defect: a new session started on the menu's first model, not the config's default
findings.scenario: config model Haiku; a new session ran on Sonnet
findings.cause: the menu's first option was taken before the config arrived
findings.fix: the menus start from the defaults until the person picks

findings.defect: today's spend stayed at $0 while a session spent
findings.scenario: a turn ended at $0.07; the status line still said $0 today
findings.cause: today was read once from the state, not from the sessions as they update
findings.fix: today is summed from the sessions on every update

findings.defect: undo of a file git does not track removed the whole file, not only the agent's lines
findings.scenario: the agent appended to a new untracked notes.txt; Undo removed the file
findings.cause: git has no earlier version of an untracked file
findings.fix: the button says Remove and the confirm says the whole file goes (it is saved first)

measurements.name: live pass with a real model
measurements.gate: plan approval, own copy with commit, refused merge, image, ! command, Y key, grade and undo each work once
measurements.result: all worked; a made-up test image was refused by the API (the test's fault: a real PNG worked)

measurements.name: dclab-code tests
measurements.gate: every server, unit and page test passes

outcome: Every new feature worked once live; three page bugs found by the live run were fixed.
lessons: A live pass finds what a fake agent cannot: what the page does with the SDK's real timing and defaults
